title: New York Street Vendors Battle Over Permits
main_content:
A conflict is forming on the streets of New York City between legal and illegal food trucks and carts.

The city grants 5,100 food vending permits every two years. The permit is issued by the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene. Most pay $200 to renew their permit every two years.

Some permit holders rent their license, or permit, for a profit. Some cart or truck operators pay more than $20,000 for a food vending permit.

Because there is a greater demand of permits, a black market for the licenses has emerged.

The Wall Street Journal reported that renting these permits to another vendor is illegal. But many vendors have turned to this illegal black market for permits.

Vendors have protested at the City Hall about the permit system. They say vendors should have a permit in their own name. Others call for more permits to be issued.

questions.question: How many permits are given every 2 years?
Why has a black market of permits emerged?
options: Due to increased fines for illegal vendors
Because of the high demand for permits
Because of a lack of food vendors
questions.answer: Because of the high demand for permits

questions.question: Is renting permits legal?
options: Yes, it's endorsed by the Department of Health
No, it's illegal according to the Wall Street Journal
Yes, as long as it's done informally
questions.answer: No, it's illegal according to the Wall Street Journal
